data.title: Driven Brands Announces Updated Capital Allocation Priorities
data.description: In Charlotte, North Carolina, Driven Brands Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: DRVN) disclosed new capital allocation priorities to boost growth and enhance shareholder returns. The company has successfully brought down its net leverage from 5.0x in 2023 to an anticipated 3.0x by the end of Q3 2026, meeting the 3.0x goal a quarter earlier than expected. The commitment to the Growth and Cash framework has proven fruitful, showcasing the company's financial resilience and strategic planning.

data.title: Philadelphia Turns Up the Heat with its First-Ever Sweet Heat Cream Cheese in the United States in Partnership with Mike's Hot Honey®
data.description: Philadelphia and Chicago have partnered to introduce a new product, Philadelphia Mike’s Hot Honey Whipped Cream Cheese, as temperatures drop. This collaboration combines the iconic sweet heat of America's leading hot honey brand, Mike’s Hot Honey, with Philadelphia's whipped cream cheese. The new spread is versatile and can be enjoyed with bagels, charcuterie boards, and even pizza. This product is now available for purchase.

data.title: BX Partners Launches Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model for Financial Advisors
data.description: BX Partners, an investment consulting platform based in Charlotte, North Carolina, has introduced the BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model. This new rules-based investment solution is tailored for chief investment officers (CIOs), financial advisors, registered investment advisers (RIAs), and broker-dealers. The model aims to assist in integrating Bitcoin into client portfolios through a disciplined and systematic approach. Accessible via the BX Index platform, this model offers a structured investment process.

data.title: Neuberger and KKR to Invest in Datavant Alongside New Mountain Capital
data.description: Datavant, a healthcare data collaboration platform, has recently received investment from Neuberger Capital Solutions and KKR. Funds managed by Neuberger Capital Solutions and Neuberger Private Markets, together with investment funds managed by KKR, will acquire a notable minority stake in Datavant. This announcement comes as New Mountain Capital, an existing investor in Datavant since 2014, will continue to be involved with the company. This strategic move is set to enhance Datavant's position and further establish its presence in the healthcare data industry.

data.title: Solstice Gold Closes Acquisition of the Leckie Gold Zone and 43 New Claims, Consolidating New 57 km2 Gold Play in the Abitibi Subprovince, Ontario
data.description: Solstice Gold Corp. (TSXV: SGC) based in Vancouver, Canada, has successfully completed the acquisition of two patented claims covering a total area of 24 hectares that contain the Leckie Gold Zone ("LGZ"). The LGZ comprises a 160-meter deep shaft, underground works spanning five levels, and over 23,000 meters of previous drilling activities confirming substantial historical deposits of gold and silver. This development follows the company's announcement on August 24, 2026.

data.title: Cebreo Medical Receives CE Mark for NeuroBuds®, a Discreet In-Ear, Medical-Grade EEG Wearable for Extended Ambulatory Monitoring
data.description: Cebreo Medical's NeuroBuds, an in-ear EEG wearable, has recently obtained CE marking. This certification permits the sale of NeuroBuds throughout the European Union.

data.title: D-Wave to Showcase Unique Dual-Platform Quantum Computing at Quantum World Congress 2026
data.description: D-Wave Quantum Inc. (QBTS) disclosed today that it will be a platinum sponsor at the Quantum World Congress 2026, located in College Park, Maryland from September 23 to 25. As a leading quantum computing firm offering annealing and gate-model systems, software, and services, D-Wave aims to showcase the multi-platform nature of the quantum era at the event. The company will emphasize the diversity of quantum computing technologies available.

data.title: Filigran Partners with SEK to Bring Managed Threat Intelligence to Latin America
data.description: A European open-source threat management company, Filigran, has recently revealed a collaboration with SEK, a major cybersecurity provider in Latin America. SEK is set to integrate analyst-vetted intelligence and exposure validation into its managed security services for businesses across Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, and Peru. By leveraging OpenCTI for the intelligence layer, SEK analysts will enhance their SOC workflows with detailed threat information, further strengthening cybersecurity measures in the region. This partnership marks a significant step in bolstering cybersecurity efforts in key Latin American markets.

data.title: CalmiGo Selected for CMS’s ACCESS Program to Provide Technology-Supported Chronic Care for Behavioral Health Conditions
data.description: In New York, CalmiGo, the creator of a unique mental health platform for anxiety, PTSD, and panic attacks, has been chosen for CMS's ACCESS program. This program aims to provide technology-supported chronic care for behavioral health conditions. With Medicare catering to more than 70 million individuals, this selection highlights the platform's ability to offer immediate relief and long-term support. Additionally, fourteen more programs have been included in the initiative to broaden access to such care.

data.title: Challenger Gold Limited Begins Trading on OTCQX Best Market
data.description: On September 15, 2026, OTC Markets Group Inc. declared that Challenger Gold Limited (ASX: CEL; OTCQX: CLLEF), a gold and copper exploration company, has met the criteria to be listed on the OTCQX® Best Market. Challenger Gold Limited has moved up from the OTCQB® Venture Market to the OTCQX, denoting a significant advancement in its trading status.
